instruction: Candid outdoor medium full shot from a low angle of a group posing in a sunny park with green grass and background trees. In the center foreground, the East Asian man in a red polo shirt (R3) crouches with his hands clasped, smiling gently at the camera. Behind him on the left, the Black woman with an afro (R6) in a red t-shirt stands smiling, giving a thumbs up. On the right, the Black woman in a black beanie (R5) in a red t-shirt stands back-to-back with her, facing right in profile with hands clapped together. The group poses playfully in a tight formation. Bright, natural sunlight filters through the trees, casting soft shadows on the vibrant green lawn.
